_v1_notes.TARGET|SENSOR: ballistic midcourse is detectable only by long-range early warning: fire-control radar lacks the range, EO cannot see into space, and the warhead does not emit. Low-observable aircraft defeat both radars by cross-section but are trackable by EO and by their own emissions. A quadcopter is too small for either radar and usually too quiet on RF. A balloon is huge and slow so early warning and EO see it, but it presents no fire-control return and does not emit.
_v1_notes.TARGET|EFFECTOR: only the exoatmospheric interceptor reaches a midcourse ballistic target, and it is useless against everything inside the atmosphere. Guns cannot reach an aircraft or a balloon at altitude. Jamming has no effect on a ballistic trajectory or an inertially guided aircraft, but does defeat a quadcopter's control link and a cruise missile's satellite navigation.
_v1_notes.TARGET|ENGAGEMENT AUTHORITY: a ballistic missile engagement is strategic, so national and regional authority only. A quadcopter over one's own installation is the opposite: too fast and too local for anything above a battery commander. Automated rules apply only where the threat is unambiguous, which excludes a manned aircraft and a balloon.
_v1_notes.SENSOR|EFFECTOR: early warning cues only the exoatmospheric interceptor; it cannot provide a weapons-quality track for anything else. Fire-control radar cannot guide an exoatmospheric interceptor, which does not operate on that principle. EO supports guns and jamming at close range. Passive RF gives bearing only, sufficient to aim a jammer but not to guide a missile or a gun.
_v1_notes.SENSOR|ENGAGEMENT AUTHORITY: early warning at strategic range pairs with strategic authority, not with a battery commander or an automated rule. Fire-control and EO are tactical and pair with everything below national level.
_v1_notes.EFFECTOR|ENGAGEMENT AUTHORITY: an exoatmospheric interceptor is a strategic weapon and is never delegated below national authority. Guns and jamming are terminal defence and are never held at national level.
